experiment_data.hypothesis: Leave-one-task-type-out eval: router 在完全未见 task type 上是否 ≈ 50%（随机），确认 routing signal 不跨 task type 迁移，仅学了 task-type 分类。关联 C2 diagnostic。
experiment_data.notes: LOTO eval completed. 7/11 task types are single-class (all deterministic) → bal_acc N/A. Only 4 task types have both det+internal: chemistry-mix, find-non-living-thing, grow-fruit, lifespan-longest-lived-then-shortest-lived. Grand mean bal_acc on 2-class types: 59.76±1.84%, significantly above majority-vote baseline (50%) and cross-split reference (47.1±2.2%). Router shows non-trivial generalization within task types, contradicting the hypothesis that routing signal doesn't transfer. Results saved to results/leave_one_tasktype_out/results.json.
